title: One Pufferfish Holds Enough Poison to Kill 30 Adults

scenes.text: One pufferfish carries enough poison to kill thirty adults.
The toxin is up to 1,200 times deadlier than cyanide.
And there is no known antidote.
When threatened, it gulps water and swells to several times its size.
Here is the twist: the fish does not even make the poison. Bacteria in its food do.
Thirty adults. In one small fish.

description:
One pufferfish can contain enough tetrodotoxin to kill about 30 adult humans.
The toxin is up to 1,200 times more poisonous than cyanide and has no known antidote. It originates from bacteria that the fish picks up through its food.
Would you ever try fugu? Tell us below.
first_comment: Fugu chefs in Japan need years of training and a licence before they can serve it. Would you eat it?
